visualCharacteristics.purpose: grid of photo tiles, each showing a model name and availability count and linking to that model's results

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: image | category (comma-separated filter tokens, e.g. "v12, serie-speciali") | text (model name, "N disponibili", link)

reuseGuidance: Use for the model catalogue grid; pair with model-filter, whose tab labels (slugified) must match the tile categories.
